description: Weekly usage limits added on top of 5-hour rolling sessions for Pro/Max: overall weekly cap plus separate Opus cap. Announced July 28, 2025; effective August 28, 2025. Anthropic stated <5% of users affected; aimed at 24/7 Claude Code use and account sharing. Reported ranges at launch: Pro 40–80 hrs Sonnet 4/week; Max 5x 140–280 hrs Sonnet + 15–35 hrs Opus; Max 20x 240–480 + 24–40 (reported only).
user_reaction: Documented developer backlash, esp. Claude Code power users; later temporary weekly-limit boosts reported into 2026

description: Pro changed from $20/mo for 500 fast requests to $20/mo API-rate compute credit pool plus unlimited Auto (auto-routed models); Ultra ($200/mo) introduced. Effective usage fell to roughly 225 Sonnet-4 requests vs the former 500. 'Unlimited' applied only to Auto, which was widely misunderstood.
notice_period: none — announced via blog but rollout poorly communicated; clarified June 30
grandfathering: none for the request model; full refunds offered for surprise charges June 16–July 4 via pro-pricing@cursor.com after July 4 public apology ('we missed the mark')
user_reaction: Documented backlash: surprise overages (reports of $350+/week), mass complaints, public apology and refunds

description: 'Updates to Teams and Auto' — adjustments to Teams plans and Auto usage; Pro+ tier appears on the pricing page in this era (exact launch date not verified from primary source).
